html:
A little extra security behind the scenes this week: we caught and blocked a run of fake "episode" downloads that were actually disguised malware, and demoted the source that kept serving them, so your library stays safe and clean.

We also gave TV shows more breathing room before a stalled episode gets parked, so your favorites have a better shot at catching up on their own.

A few smaller reliability tune-ups round things out. 🎬
